lines.text: The LORD pronounces woe on rebellious children who form an alliance against His will and go down to Egypt without asking Him.
Their princes are at Memphis and their envoys have arrived in Hanes, but the people bring neither help nor benefit.
They carry their wealth on donkeys and camels through a land of lions and vipers, and Egypt is called Rahab Who Sits Still.
Because they rejected the message, their iniquity will collapse suddenly like a potter's jar, with no fragment large enough to scoop coals.
The LORD said repentance and rest would save them, but they chose to flee on camels, and a thousand will flee at the threat of one.
